## Portfolio auto-blog

**Pipeline:** manual trigger (Execute workflow) -> fetch Hacker News front page -> dedup vs existing posts -> LLM drafts a post in the blog's voice -> validate front-matter + build slug -> commit to `app/blogs/`.

**Credentials needed (select on the nodes):**
1. `List existing blogs` + `Commit to GitHub` — GitHub credential (PAT with repo contents write access). See workflows/README.md for setup steps.
2. `Draft blog` — Header Auth credential: Name `Authorization`, Value `Bearer <your z.ai Coding Plan key>`. Uses z.ai's OpenAI-compatible **Coding Plan** endpoint (`api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4`), model `glm-4.6`. If your key is a standard API key instead, change the URL to `api.z.ai/api/paas/v4`.

**Notes:**
- Runs on click (Manual trigger) — no schedule. Use the **Execute workflow** button.
- Change the `model` field in `Draft blog`'s JSON body to use a different GLM model.
- Swap the topic source by replacing `Get trending topics` with any HTTP node (dev.to API, Reddit, etc.).
- The site redeploys automatically via GitHub Actions on push to main; the sitemap is generated at build time, so new posts are picked up automatically.

## Recommended: review before it goes live
Committing straight to `main` deploys unreviewed AI content to a recruiter-facing portfolio instantly.

**Safer alternative:** in `Commit to GitHub`, change `branch` from `main` to `auto-blog`, then open a PR from:
`github.com/vibhuvV/portfolio/compare/main...auto-blog`

Even better: insert a n8n **Send and Wait** node (email/Slack approval) between `Validate & slug` and `Commit to GitHub` so nothing lands without a human click.
